Name: Elliott Learns Politeness
Author: MidnightVoyager
Description:
My first code mod! This mod edits the event with Elliott where he's kinda rude to you and Gus in the tavern to allow you to point it out. It's not a big conversation, just a little exchange before the toast.

Elliott's whole vibe suggested to me a guy who learned more from books than interacting with other people, and the gesture of calling to an unnamed bartender for a drink for your friend who hasn't ordered yet is very "character in a book" behavior. I don't think he'd want to be rude to anybody. So now you can point it out.

Also I know some people don't drink even in games, so I added in options for that while I was at it.

Thanks to EnderTedi for help when I stumbled a bit!

Downloads.Description: All under the hood changes, just future-proofing compatibility.

Manifest.Name: Elliott Learns Politeness
Manifest.Description: Added a bit to the saloon event with Elliott. Allows you to reject alcohol and suggest he's not being polite.
